Warehousing

ประสิทธิภาพการหยิบสินค้า

A key warehouse KPI reflecting how quickly and accurately pickers fulfill orders, calculated from time and error rates as recorded in WMS/picking logs, critical for performance audits.

Quick answer: A key warehouse KPI reflecting how quickly and accurately pickers fulfill orders, calculated from time and error rates as recorded in WMS/picking logs, critical for performance audits.

Quick answer

A key warehouse KPI reflecting how quickly and accurately pickers fulfill orders, calculated from time and error rates as recorded in WMS/picking logs, critical for performance audits.

Why it matters

ประสิทธิภาพการหยิบสินค้า matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A key warehouse KPI reflecting how quickly and accurately pickers fulfill orders, calculated from time and error rates as recorded in WMS/picking logs, critical for performance audits.

Operational example

Improving picking efficiency requires analyzing pick rates and error trends in WMS reports and adjusting warehouse processes accordingly.
